paragraphs.text: Vado Thal is a merfolk wizard ally from Zendikar .

Vado Thal is a a famed field scholar and linguist who was trained at the Lighthouse at Sea Gate . As a student of ancient languages, Vado analyzed the lore and relics "acquired" by his fellow adventurers, and in turn fed them clues about what to expect in the ruins ahead. He has been referred to as a living library and loremaster.
